units.title: Пассив 2: is being done / has been done
units.shortDescription: Пассив в продолженном и перфектном временах + с модальными.
units.theoryHtml:
Пассив = be + V3. Время и вид несёт глагол be:

ВремяАктивПассив
Present ContinuousThey are building the bridge.The bridge is being built.
Present PerfectThey have painted the wall.The wall has been painted.
Past SimpleThey built it in 1990.It was built in 1990.
FutureThey will open it soon.It will be opened soon.
с модальнымиYou must do it.It must be done.

Пассив с модальными: must/can/should/may + be + V3: The window must be fixed. Tickets can be bought online.

⚠ Частые ошибки: The bridge is building → is being built (забыли being). It has being done → has been done (been, не being). It must done → must be done. Кем? — by: It was painted by Picasso.

Мини-диалог:
— Why is the road closed? — The bridge is being repaired. — Again? It was repaired only last year!
— I know. The new road will be opened next month. The bill must be paid by the city.

exercises.prompt: Look! A new stadium ___ over there.

exercises.explanation: Present Perfect пассив — hasn't been fixed.

exercises.prompt: This form ___ be filled in black ink.

options: The house is being painted now.
The house has being painted now.
The house is been painted now.

exercises.prompt: My car ___ ___ (чинят) right now. (is being repaired)
The thief ___ ___ (был арестован) by the police. (was arrested)

units.title: want you to do / make him do / let her go
units.shortDescription: Complex object: три схемы «заставить/позволить/попросить кого-то сделать».
units.theoryHtml:
По-русски: «Я хочу, чтобы ты сделал». По-английски структура другая — want + someone + to do:

СхемаПример
want/ask/tell + sb + to doI want you to help me. She told him to wait.
make + sb + do (заставить)They made me work all night.
let + sb + do (позволить)My parents let me stay out late.
help + sb + (to) doHe helped me carry it.

make/let — БЕЗ to! Но в пассиве make возвращает to: I was made to work.

⚠ Частые ошибки: «Я хочу, чтобы ты пришёл» → I want that you come ✗ → I want you to come. My mom let me to go → let me go. make me to laugh → make me laugh.

Мини-диалог:
— I want you to be honest with me. — I am! — Then tell me who made you do it. — Nobody! They just let me borrow the car.

exercises.prompt: My parents didn't let me ___ late.
The teacher made us ___ the essay again.
I was made ___ overtime last week.
exercises.explanation: Пассив make — to возвращает: made to work.

options: He wants that I to come.

exercises.prompt: They told us ___ about the delay.
exercises.explanation: Отрицание в tell sb to: not to worry.

exercises.prompt: My boss made ___ ___ (меня переделать) the report.

units.title: stop/remember/forget + -ing vs to
units.shortDescription: I stopped smoking vs I stopped to smoke — смысл меняется.
units.theoryHtml:
Некоторые глаголы меняют смысл в зависимости от того, что за ними: -ing или to do:

Глагол+ -ing+ to do
stopперестал делать: I stopped smoking. (бросил курить)остановился, чтобы сделать: I stopped to smoke. (остановился — покурить)
rememberпомню, что делал: I remember locking the door.не забыть сделать: Remember to lock the door!
forgetзабыл, что делал: I forgot meeting him.чуть не забыл сделать: I forgot to meet him. (и не встретил)
tryпробовать способы: Try restarting it.стараться (сложно): I tried to open it.
regretсожалею о прошлом: I regret saying that.жалею сообщать: I regret to inform you...

enjoy/avoid/mind/suggest/finish — всегда + -ing: I enjoy reading, avoid making mistakes. want/decide/hope/promise/plan — всегда + to do: I decided to stay.

⚠ Частые ошибки: I enjoy to read → enjoy reading. I decided going → decided to go. Remember locking the door! (когда просишь) → Remember to lock.

Мини-диалог:
— Why did you stop working? — I stopped to drink some water. I was dying of thirst!
— OK. And please remember to send the file. — I remember sending it this morning!

exercises.prompt: On the way home, we stopped ___ some petrol.
Remember ___ the lights when you leave.
exercises.explanation: Не забыть сделать — to turn off.

exercises.prompt: I remember ___ this film as a child.
Try ___ the router — it might help.

options: I avoid to drive at night.
I avoid to driving at night.
